svg.aria-label: 目标联系，不表示充分精化
svg.text: 独立于成立精化；箭头按联系类型解释，状态逐项标明。

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Notify the driver directly instead of changing the pickup point in the app when the pickup
point needs to change. → Be able to change the pickup point easily after a ride is booked
when the ride starts from the current location.

g.aria-label: 待确认联系 · 有助于
g.text: 待确认联系 · 有助于
Give the driver a heads-up when an intermediate stop on a multi-stop trip takes longer tha
n expected. → Keep any intermediate stop on a multi-stop trip as short as possible.
